shape_definitions.empty: An existing polynomial with zero terms.
shape_definitions.one_rational_term: One term at any pi power with no radicals or atoms; this does not mean the value is rational.
shape_definitions.one_radical_term: One term at any pi power with exactly one radical and no atoms; the rational coefficient part is unrestricted.
shape_definitions.other_closed: Any other polynomial with no opaque atoms.
shape_definitions.opaque: Any polynomial containing at least one opaque atom; this takes priority over term/radical shape.
